alias: all distinct unless specifically stated; no partial overlap
math: Build with --ftz=false --fmad=false. The default follows the fast forward; define AD_NUMERICS_STRICT for strict. Replay the executed helper and flush masks with preserved subnormals in the derivative.
cotangent_ownership: The output seed is read-only; b_current and b_accumulator_in accumulate separately, including when primal accumulator is overwritten.
post_forward_read: Use the saved pre-overwrite accumulator for masks; accumulator is the post-forward output.
route_reason: The fast forward flushes value-dependent subnormal operands or results, so its active-input map is piecewise rather than a fixed linear map. The accompanying opspec describes only the unflushed linear arm and must not replace this branch-aware hand rule.
linear_opspec_scope: Only the ordinary unflushed arm; not a whole-domain exact derivative.
branch_record_status: TL and AD count each executed predicate in uint32[slots][2] arm counters; compile-time inactive arms remain zero.
piecewise_affine_arms: Each fixed combination of early, fallback, operand DAZ, and result FTZ masks is an affine map in current and old accumulator; result and operand rounding follow the executed path.
strict_decode_record: Slots include the two conditional operand decodes, their conditional sign choices, the result packing threshold and its conditional sign choice, recomputed only on the strict FP64 fallback.
